title: Kūpuna locally grown produce pilot
summary: A small pilot program that delivers locally grown fruits and vegetables to kūpuna began last week, and its next distribution is set for tomorrow at a community center. The first delivery included bananas, dragon fruit and carrots, plus a jar of squash and sweet potato soup. The idea was raised at the Council on Aging almost two years ago; the program aims to reach rural communities, and the office wants good data before expanding it.
